messages.author: verygeeky
messages.text: I built this as a play surface.  Conceptually, it's figuring out which OPs or combinations are flexibile enough to surface to mutate a given existing sketch and adapt it as a "scene."  It functions as a module/plugin framework.  Each network "plugin" exposes standard in/outs.  Each plugin contains a DAT that exposes the labels, and defaults for "paremeters" (parameters exposed by the scene itself. - sliders impact those. Another "in scene" DAT for scene-specific presets ("oo, i like that look").   Scene plugins usually take about 10 minutes of understanding one of my random saved .toe's and figuring out what to expose/how or have claude do it.  The gradients are literally just DATs with ramp definitions, global effectors are networks that apply to any scene and mutates a single deck (or can be applied to master out).  Need to add a mixer network to the top (compositing options, mostly) I've got Ableton link (omg, pulse is awesome!), OSC, MIDI, and some oddball automators working (X or Y axis on fingers from media pipe, for instance!).
